metadata.description: MCP context usage thresholds with manual headroom for resource/template growth. tools baseline/threshold reconciled to current main: #4390 (observe.scope, ~433 tokens) and #4396 (observe.project, ~108 tokens) both merged over the non-required benchmark without raising the threshold, and #3490 adds openLink's integrated waitFor (the whole predicate surface, previously observe-only) plus absent/settled (~194 tokens after trimming shared waitFor descriptions).
